We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have to produce JSON route where each reaction node uses those template IDs sequentially, starting from target molecule and going backwards to precursors.

We need to apply each template to get precursors. We have applied first template 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three SMILES). The result from apply_template gave a tuple of three strings? Actually result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO',))"

So three possible precursors. Need to choose one that matches next template 1914389. We checked first precursor (with Si group) matches 1914389 (True). Good. So we can use that as product of first reaction? Actually retrosynthesis: target -> apply template 29646 -> precursors (choose one). Then next step apply template 1914389 to that precursor to get further precursors.

We applied 1914389 to that precursor and got result: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),)". So two precursors: one is a complex with Si and carbonyl, the other is "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". Need to pick one that matches next template 1914390. We tried both and both false. So maybe need to choose different branch from first step.

We have three options from first template. Let's test each with 1914389.

Option 2: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO". We checked matching 1914389 false. Option 3: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". Check? Not yet. Let's test.
